name: Sexual Fantasies
overview: Scripture calls believers to guard their hearts diligently, recognizing that the inner thoughts and desires shape the course of life (Proverbs 4:23). Sexual fantasies, particularly those rooted in lust, are cautioned against as they equate to adultery in the heart (Matthew 5:28) and can lead one away from purity and fellowship with God (Matthew 5:8). The call to forsake unrighteous thoughts and return to the Lord’s mercy underscores the need for repentance and heart transformation (Isaiah 55:7). Ultimately, earthly desires such as marriage and lust have no place in the resurrection life, pointing believers to a higher, holy standard (Matthew 22:30).
